coreMechanic.note: Stay-quiet mechanic is instantly clear; defuse condition (fuse<25%+5s silence) adds genuine depth and skill ceiling. Fuse burn rates balanced.

visualDesign.note: Playing phase is visually excellent: bomb shake, fuse color transition (green→amber→red), volume meter, near-miss banner. Start screen could show more content before interaction.

audioDesign.note: Exceptional: pulse heartbeat music perfectly themes the bomb. Complete SFX coverage with correct timing sync. Music tempo escalation at 15s and 8s creates genuine tension arc. Near-miss, defuse, boom all land.

sensorIntegration.note: Ambient calibration (1s baseline subtraction) reduces false triggers. Touch fallback implemented (press-and-hold) for denied/unavailable mic.

performance.note: DOM-based game loop. No canvas/WebGL rendering overhead. AnalyserNode at fftSize=256 (minimal FFT). Memory stays <50MB across 3 play-agains. No leak vectors.

accessibility.note: WCAG AA contrast passes (test 9.3). Touch targets ≥44px. Clear language. Haptics not URL-param toggleable (same gap in all games). Mic fallback ensures motor accessibility.

polish.note: Near-miss banner, bomb shake animation, score pop on quiet streaks, green victory flash on defuse, streak badge. Comprehensive micro-interactions.

dataPersonality.note: Three deterministic personalities (Calm/Explosive/Reactive) with clear behavioral logic. Four meaningful signals: noiseSpikes, avgVolume, dangerSeconds, fuseRemaining. Webhook fires correctly.

notes: Tests 1.1/1.2 use 120s timeout for Turbopack first-compile (passes after warmup)
Test 8.1 rAF FPS measures 9fps in headless — this is browser background throttling artifact, not a game issue. DOM-based game has no heavy rendering; timer decrement verified at correct rate.
Test 2.5 back button: router.push('/') — SPA navigation, confirmed URL changes away from whisper-bomb path.

bugs.title: No mic fallback when microphone permission denied
bugs.description: When getUserMedia throws (permission denied/unavailable), game returned to start screen with error message. Design rules require touch fallback for mic games.
bugs.fix: Added micFallback state. handleStart/handlePlayAgain now set micFallback=true and proceed to game when mic unavailable. Touch press-and-hold button (vol=55 while held, 0 on release) renders during gameplay when micFallback=true. getVolume() returns touchVolumeRef.current when analyser is null.

bugs.title: Dead sprite loading code causes 404 console errors
bugs.description: Module-level _loadSprite('/sprites/whisper-bomb/bomb.svg') and _loadSprite('/sprites/whisper-bomb/spark.svg') ran on every page load. Sprite files don't exist in public/. Caused 404 errors in console. Game uses BombIcon component instead.
bugs.fix: Removed entire _spriteCache / _loadSprite dead code block from page.tsx.

creativeReview.idea: Your silence is the weapon — a social experiment disguised as a 45-second bomb game that turns ambient noise into data.

cannes_craft_emotion.note: Emotional truth is authentic — being quiet in a noisy world has universal tension. The bomb exploding is funny, not punishing.

webby_digital_flow.note: Mechanic communicates itself immediately. Volume meter + fuse bar = perfect feedback loop. Play-again is instant.

awwwards_visual_risk.note: Playing phase is visually strong. Start screen needs more presence. The bomb + fuse color system is distinctive.

grammy_audio.note: The pulse heartbeat for a bomb game is inspired. Full SFX coverage. Music tempo escalation is the best example in the library.

clio_originality.note: Not just 'be quiet' — the defuse mechanic adds strategy. Noise as behavioral data is genuinely original insight.

disney_magic.note: Magic moment exists: bomb shake + red glow + accelerating heartbeat at fuse < 35%. The green victory flash on defuse is the earned payoff.

creativeReview.magicMoment: The bomb shaking more violently as fuse drops below 35% — the visual, audio, and haptic all intensify together. This is the moment that changes someone's face.
creativeReview.thePlus: Add a crowd-visible 'Defused!' vs 'BOOM!' result announcement card that would display on an event screen — makes the individual result social and creates a shared moment.
whatIsWorking: Pulse heartbeat music is the single best music-mechanic match in the library
The three personality types (Calm/Explosive/Reactive) are immediately understandable and shareable
Real-time volume meter + fuse bar creates a perfect two-signal feedback system
The defuse mechanic (fuse<25% + 5s silence) rewards strategy without requiring explanation
Music tempo escalation creates genuine physiological anxiety — it works
whatIsMissing: Start screen has no hero moment — the bomb illustration appears but the BombIcon is small in the CTA area; should be a large ambient presence before the game starts
No crowd/social dimension — Whisper Bomb is uniquely suited to a group challenge (can the whole room stay quiet?) that's not surfaced anywhere
The 'Calm 🧘' outcome requires the near-impossible defuse — most players will never experience it; needs more discoverability
creativeReview.requiredChangesBeforeShip: None — SHIP WITH NOTES. All required changes are enhancements.

avoidFor: Any activation with sustained background noise >50dB
deploymentGuidance.recommendation: Deploy with ambient calibration (already implemented). Brief staff before events in loud venues — touch fallback now allows play but defuse won't be achievable. Consider signage: 'Can you silence 200 people for 5 seconds?' for group deployment.
